label: Ikony · Robot
desc: Přípravný krok doprostřed, robot podle kostry z Mixama, vypnutí a zapnutí.
desc_en: A setup step to the center, the robot driven by a Mixamo skeleton, a power-down and a power-up.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer lets go of anything they are holding, takes two steps away from the wall toward the center of the room and stops with feet together and flat on the floor, arms hanging loose, facing the camera
the dancer does the robot dance with stiff mechanical movements, photorealistic, same clothes and room
the dancer powers down: the head drops forward and the arms fall loose as the body slumps, and stays slumped
the dancer powers back up in jerky steps, head lifting last, and locks into a rigid stare at the camera
